scope: runner/helper package contract audit; offline only
coverageCaveat: Every packaged file has structural disposition. Only listed deep-read/selected sections received semantic review. AST parse, schema checks, and passing tests do not establish every-line semantics, actual agent behavior or runtime qualification.

headings: # M2 capability matrix — separate observation levels
## Existing-target binding — implemented; independent integration evidence
# M2 existing Docker target — public/API only
## Owner completion and planning (no target traffic)
## Pilot (only after all owner and binding gates)
## Commands đã dùng và cách tái lập
# Delegated DAST candidate và actual live ZAP sink controls
## Actual sink diagnostic có thể thực thi
## Điều kiện còn thiếu trước product
# W0 — Khóa contract và dừng tại G0
## Contract đã chọn cho implementation tiếp theo
# W10 — regression A→B và CI exit mapping
# W11 — alternate conformance, compatibility và handoff
## Alternate product và core dùng chung
## Compatibility, operational limits và next action
# W1 — Coverage có binding và oracle
# W2 — Verifier v2 độc lập; điểm dừng G2
## Oracle độc lập và binding fixture
# W3 — Registry, chặn mode và chuẩn bị secret gate
## Lệnh đã chuẩn bị để tái kiểm
## Reforecast W3 và điểm bàn giao
# W4 — effective policy, resource gate và partial/stop evidence
# W4 continuation — transport denial, policy containment và runtime faults
# W4 — Policy, resource preflight và evidence partial
## Journal, atomic writer và kênh dự phòng
## Entry point và cách tái kiểm
# W5 — checkpoint auth lifecycle và canary auditor
# W5 — resource profile đo được và canary source cô lập
## Amendment scope tester theo người dùng
# W6 — fixture động và oracle business/BOLA
# W7 — browser session spike và UI E2E diagnostic
# W8 — active controls trên fixture SQLi và reflected XSS
# W9 — normalized orchestration và stop-only recovery
## Plan và các track bắt buộc

Synthetic integration example. No client, product defaults or plugin loading.

executor's admission, target/auth binding and ownership checks. This example is
not registered in the CLI allowlist and grants no authority itself.
Owned, no-network live ZAP history/session positive control. No product input.
Anonymous research entry. Direct/native POST campaigns, MCP reports; strict auth unchanged.

Read back an owned W5 diagnostic and enumerate exact BE secret-proof gaps.

Offline only: this is a proof inventory, not a product runtime attestor. No URL,
credential, admission override or execution command is accepted. Output is new and
outside the sealed bundle; G3 and product G4 remain blocked.

Run the explicit native be-authenticated research contract on finalsource-zap-test.

No legacy P0 override. No strict secret-safe claim. Uses a dedicated ZAP + MCP pair,
upstream MCP client/parsers, native context/user seeds and guided crawl/attack.
Foreground real MCP/ZAP integration against independently owned synthetic target.
Bounded BOLA direct research; no ZAP active scan authority implied.

Delete only accounts owned by fresh fixture actors in a verified research bundle.

No user/category/goal delete API exists; those rows are retained. No DB mutation,
reset, target restart or retry after uncertain DELETE ACK. Evidence stays intact.
Persist explicitly FAKE fault evidence; never represents scanner integration.
FE anonymous research (finite browser journeys through isolated native ZAP).

Explicitly authorized local finalsource P0 pilot; separate from v1.4 read-only BOLA.

APIs. All scanner traffic crosses a method/path guard. Borrowed app containers
are inspected only, never exec'd, restarted or removed. Output must be new.

Collect legacy pilot observations without promoting them to v2 oracle proof.

A published/historical bundle is read-only: use --output with a fresh directory.
The reusable bound predicate lives in zap_assessment.coverage; legacy observations
lack its required correlations and remain explicitly inconclusive.

Run-local finalsource mirror and private API client. No Docker socket or DB access.

Only this UID may reach the borrowed frontend. The scanner reaches the mirror.
Native mode forwards exact fixture login; delegated mode holds real JWTs here,
accepts an actor-specific non-secret browser marker and injects at the last hop.
No automatic reauthentication: a real 401 latches authLost and removes the token.
Foreground synthetic ZAP campaign: two isolated runs, interruption and lost ACK.

Create exactly two owned category fixtures when the app has no creation API.

The current user authorizes dedicated test data, not DB reset or existing-row
updates. DB credentials exist only in process memory/stdin. A network-restricted
one-shot client verifies actor identities and inserts two new rows in a transaction.
Never retries a write after an ambiguous ACK. No borrowed container exec/restart.
Locked Linux peer/source controls; no product reference, URL or secret input.
Explicit multi-product backend entry. Legacy CLIs retain their scope and readers.
Validate existing manifests or collect source candidates from a requested product location.

Offline W0 contract/baseline checks. This command has no live execution path.

This is a development checkpoint, not the v2 coverage or semantic verifier.

Owned W4 anonymous fixture: locked normal runs and isolated negative cases.

Owned anonymous scanner calibration; never a product or authenticated scan.

Locked synthetic W5 development campaign. No product/scanner admission.

Locked canary-only W5 integration on owned Docker ZAP/MCP, never finalsource.

primitives. No anonymous assessment manifest is published for protected traffic.
Prepare, compare and independently replay pinned W10 offline A→B evidence.
Pinned offline W11 conformance/handoff; no authority or independent approval.
Owned synthetic W6 HTTP campaign. Never accepts a product URL or credentials.
Owned synthetic browser diagnostic. No product URL, credential input or ZAP.
Owned W8 active fixture. No product URL, credentials, shared ZAP or admission.

Offline semantic/tamper controls on actual W9 evidence. Zero product traffic.
Deterministic direct-mode assessment orchestration. No implicit authority.
Owned W8 SQLite/HTML sinks. No product URL, auth or external dependencies.

Question-level readback, separate from caller-supplied generic mutation labels.

does not infer business semantics, identity or sinks from an HTTP status alone.
Offline independent W8 oracle. Checksums/Complete/empty alerts cannot verify depth.
Real pinned ZAP active controls in one owned network-none namespace.
Two explicit runtime adapters; profiles cannot load code or shell commands.
Versioned anonymous research admission. Authenticated/strict contracts unchanged.
Owned vulnerable/fixed technique controls; never product code.
Fresh local SQLite/XSS controls through the same native scanner and guard.
Stdlib-only exact anonymous workload guard; also runnable in pinned boundary image.
Derived private-local handoff, preserving native reports and classification.
Private, pinned seed bodies for discovered public auth; never session propagation.
Finalsource qualification recipe. Facts come from current source/deployment/spec.
Anonymous research orchestration: admission -> native traffic -> MCP reports -> cleanup.
Dedicated backend HTTP namespace, reusing DockerRuntime ownership and transport.
Owned third-domain HTTP control, never an example/finalsource deployment substitute.

Per-actor delegated auth candidate. Does not grant P0/runtime admission.

Transport and identity parsing belong to the adapter. Credentials are never part
of the journal API. A lock serializes identity, forwarding, refresh and loss: after
the loss latch no new protected request may enter the transport. An earlier proof
does not prove continuity up to a later request; those intervals remain uncertain.
Registered Docker HTTP binding contracts. No target provisioning or authority minting.
One resource, one object GET. No ZAP, cookie jar, fixture writes or plugins.
Narrow borrowed Docker login/account read entry. No target provisioning or mutations.
Isolated synthetic account contract. Only this server owns its in-memory fixtures.
Bounded standard-library HTTP exchange; also the isolated Docker stdin worker.
Profile-to-bundle entry for one owned synthetic account fixture; no product traffic.

Policy-aware direct BOLA research. Legacy v1.4 and W6 are unchanged.

The core knows actors/resources/requests, never product routes or field names.
Saved observations are minimized client evidence, not wire/platform attestation.
Branch applicability and proof rollup; 1.0 historical inventories stay readable.

Independent selected-state checker. No runner/oracle/evaluate imports.

Expected state is derived from declared API inputs, not from DB observations.
This is same-repository corroboration, not external/server attestation.
Narrow local-test prerequisite provisioning. Never receives DB credentials.

Continuation recipes over the existing direct client, discovery and journal.

No scanner engine or historical authority changes. DB is prerequisite/observation,
never a replacement for the API request under test.
Owned one-request fault proxy. Actual product forwarded once, no mutation replay.

Independent owned synthetic HTTP control. No core/oracle imports.

and arrived actor/method/requests are observable by the test harness independently.

Finalsource adapter: source-derived recipes, API-only fixtures, exact poststate.

W6 owned-synthetic write contract and independent state replay.

provided here. Money is scaled integer (four decimal places), never float math.
The HTTP fixture does not import this replay implementation.
Declared feature/source reconciliation, not a crawler or completeness oracle.

Independent owned HTTP product double. No oracle/adapter imports.

requests and writes its own state/arrival receipts; it never consumes transitions
or expected outcomes. Nothing here connects to finalsource or ZAP.

W6 offline verification with existing safe BundleReader and pure state replay.

The target implementation is independent. The external plan pin anchors fixture,
source and image; local receipts are synthetic evidence, not signed attestation.
Stdlib-only in-container driver. Origin fixed to this network-none fixture.

Versioned capability claims and conservative P0 admission, entirely offline.

The registry describes evidence; it never grants authority. W3 implements no
runtime gate attestor. Existing v1 entry contracts remain their own admission path.

Coverage predicate v2, independent of the pilot's status-code collector.

Inputs are a locked assertion contract and normalized raw exchanges plus boundary
records. No self-declared ``verified`` or ``oracleResult`` input is consulted.
This module does not attest a boundary's honesty or implement bundle verification.
Historical/current views only. Nothing here supplies evidence or closes work.

Credential-reference candidate for an isolated holder, not runtime admission.

Only instantiate in the allowed secret zone. Python object privacy is not process
isolation: the controller must not host this object for product credentials. The
public methods return no credential/token/hash. Existing ActorSession owns epochs,
identity checks, auth-loss latch and producer stop. Platform/sink proof is separate.

Bound work packets and durable, exclusive coordinator dispatch for workflow v2.

This is orchestration, not a transport or an authorization issuer. Callbacks must
be existing admitted executors. All coordinators sharing a scanner must use the
same state directory and resource ID. Journal/lease files are private working
state; the coordinator alone writes the canonical RUN.

Version 2 criterion review and alert-oriented handoff; no dispatch or migration.

The private working RUN remains the executable state. Reports are sanitized
projections, never an approval source or a replacement for the executor journal.

Versioned criteria-first review, without dispatch or legacy semantic migration.

This checks approval bindings, evidence joins and terminal dispositions. It cannot
verify the human behind an approval source or infer a security oracle from HTTP.
The coordinator remains responsible for those semantic judgments.

Runtime pin/epoch/admission mechanism for an isolated delegated holder.

ProofReplay is trusted executable verification, never a JSON 'allow' flag. The
production G3/platform collectors are still required; this module supplies no
default proof provider and enables no CLI/P0 mode. Unit fake replayers demonstrate
ordering/denial mechanics only, not semantic acceptance of product evidence.

Holder-local wiring of existing broker/session and finalsource adapter.

Instantiate ONLY inside an independently verified isolated holder. This Python
object is not process/platform isolation. No host CLI accepts a credential value
or reference through this module, and no default operational ProofReplay exists.

MCP scanner integration candidate; no provisioning or P0 admission override.

Reuses real schema discovery, scoped operation IDs, chunks/EOF/UTF8 readback and
the durable no-replay ledger. The isolated runtime must supply actual policy,
identity/traffic attribution and operational gate replay. This is not an entry
that accepts an arbitrary product URL/credentials.

Product-neutral discovery contract and bounded research plan compiler.

Agent interprets evidence; this layer validates references and binds requests.
It does not discover routes by guessing, execute product code or select adapters.
Derived PM report; native artifacts remain unchanged and private.

Mandatory HTTP forward guard for the isolated, anonymous, read-only fixture.

The scanner UID can connect only to this guard. Forward sockets use a fixed
literal IP/port and redirects are returned to ZAP for another origin check.
Stdlib-only common denial type for host contracts and isolated runtimes.

Schema/auth compatibility before dispatch. Does not grant scope or execute tools.

Offline source discovery and reviewed-observation provider. No inferred environment.
Bounded direct fixture lane. Never counted as browser/native anonymous assessment.

then verifies the actual driver capability. Product requests and DOM are unmodified.
PM native findings + separately attributed browser observations; private raw retained.
Explicit finalsource FE source recipe. All product routes/selectors/state live here.
Explicit, finite FE recipe registry. Names select adapters, never product detection.
FE research orchestration, native ZAP producer/report lifecycle, evidence and stop ledger.

Independent actor/session records and native bootstrap configuration.
Read-only authenticated deployment/build adapter; no login or provisioning.

Owned runtime controls and calibration; second app uses the reviewed finite recipe.
Offline authenticated FE discovery; never infer deployment or perform login.

Code-owned qualification faults. Only installed by the owned control harness.

Offline control qualification from application receipts, native history and broker records.

Readback-only semantic derivation. Never invokes worker assertions or producer evaluation.

Offline integrity and semantic readback; returns partial honestly for interrupted runs.

Finalsource subject-only adapter for a trusted isolated credential holder.

never trusts JWT claims, a login subject, or a constant role as an identity oracle.
Isolated anonymous fixture; no upstream network access or mutable product data.

Owned paired actual-sink control; raw history/cells remain private.

No product or platform acceptance follows from diagnostic samples.

and Executor; observer headers make header/body vectors explicitly unsupported.

Comparison metadata for the fixed W5 synthetic canary family.

credential resolver or operational secret gate.

helpers, or self-declared verdicts. Shared JSON schemas describe shape only.

other-actor fields and historical tokens never reach the holder/controller.
This transport does not prove host/VM persistence safety or grant admission.

Independent local Docker backend inspector, no FE/proxy dependency or environment reads.

Product location -> source discovery -> explicit recipe -> frozen plan -> existing executors.

Bounded read-only async observation polling; no mutation or policy verdicts.

Reviewed residual planning, separate from completion, authority and dispatch.

current questions and retained residuals; they cannot supply observation evidence.

containers return blocked rather than silently reducing the sink denominator.

Required secret proof denominator, shared with the stdlib-only guard.

Offline user criteria and report projections, independent of runner admission.

The tester interprets documents, applicability, observations and associations.
These helpers check declared structure and joins; they are not a policy oracle.
No document content is imported, dispatched or executed.
RS256 wire identity plus protected probe; no JWT claim-only admission or network keys.
No-product owned Linux peer/source control. Values never cross Docker I/O.

Independent hash correlation of sender, boundary and fixture-arrival records.

fuzzing and active rule acceptance remain blocked for this integration.

Strict MCP Streamable HTTP client over a docker-exec network probe.

No model evaluates target/tool text. Only registered tool names and typed arguments.
Actual isolated Firefox UI worker and private in-container canary audit.

W7 UI diagnostic contract. Reuses W6 manifest/decimal state oracle.

A browser functional pass never enables protected execution or G8 operational.
The available native-style browser session path is tested with synthetic canaries.

Owned UI target: W6 independent product double plus real browser login/forms.

minimized before persistence; no raw credential value is written or printed.
Offline W7 readback with existing safe BundleReader, no browser or network.

Small stdlib W3C WebDriver client for the already pinned Firefox image.

No browser command/request/exception payload containing credentials is persisted.
Only registered selectors and read-only DOM snapshot scripts are used.
Optional W9 parent linkage. Legacy child contracts retain their entry scope.
W9 plan and conservative aggregation. No credentials, Docker or product IO.
W9 offline readback: recompute every required child and cross-phase linkage.

Version 2 read-only bundle verification: integrity, binding, oracle, agreement.

The external plan pin is mandatory. Files are data; reports/scripts are never
executed. Semantic decisions live in an independent audit, not coverage.evaluate.
Explicit owned development workload; never registered as a product mode.

Loopback-only synthetic identity/TTL fixture, never a product adapter.

the client does not mutate tokens to simulate natural expiry. No database, shared
Docker or finalsource traffic. This fixture cannot attest ZAP secret sinks.

Bounded W5 canary calibration profile; never changes operational admission.

The historical receipt sizes justify a candidate artifact cap, not a measured
peak claim. A fresh run must stay below that cap and publish its measurements.

Owned W5 canary-only target + delegated boundary, controlled by private stdin.

No real product route, credentials, browser or arbitrary upstream is accepted.

this runtime; the host gets comparison hashes, never seed/password/token values.
ZAP receives only public fixture responses and nonsecret correlation metadata.
Stable, read-only work proposals, shared with guarded continuation.
Standalone independent test target. Credentials arrive once on stdin; logs contain actor labels only.
Test harness owns application separately from assessment's borrowed resources.
Independent synthetic application; never imported by executor or adapter.

Child-only private-file broker diagnostic. Accepts no target or credential.

child. Stdout contains counts/booleans only; this is not platform/sink acceptance.

Public unit fixtures, never runtime source/evidence or credential inputs.

W7 unit-contract corpus, NOT browser runtime evidence.

The independent target is reused; no saved corpus is called actual UI execution.
G2 tamper cases. Expected acceptance is declared before verifier execution.

Generic v2 bundle generator with independent, explicit fixture expectations.

No production builder/verifier is imported, and no network is used. This is
synthetic evidence, never a target/boundary attestation or secret-safe publisher.
W11 acceptance decision negatives. Unit views are not runtime evidence.
Independent counterexamples; unit tests do not fabricate actual scan evidence.

Separate state arithmetic/tamper corpus and real HTTP POST controls.
BOLA research risks: independent HTTP fixture, not product proof.
W6 actual HTTP plus independent state/receipt replay and rehashed tamper cases.
W3 admission and claims tests; no target credentials or runtime required.
Actual entrypoint tests with no network or nested executor process allowed.

Contract/transport variations; no target traffic or real Docker operations.
Adversarial offline evidence checks; resealing cannot legitimize a false claim.
Actual TLS requests to owned local controls, including rejection before app arrival.
Real owned TLS mutation faults; POST is never replayed.
Regression inputs built independently of the coverage predicate.
Security boundary checks: prevent fixture drift, auth crossover and fallback.
Unit negative integration; synthetic bytes are never runtime acceptance.
Health checks must traverse the engine sender after capture activation.
Cgroup measurement must work without tools inside distroless workloads.
PM audit O01–O07 and 16 acceptance scenarios. Offline, no target/Scanner access.
Skill-local imports and CLI routing without Docker, traffic or a dev checkout.
Execute the generated native guard JS in an isolated VM; no ZAP or product traffic.
W10 decision counterexamples. Normalized unit views are not runtime proof.
Checks for the offline G0 checkpoint, not coverage/security acceptance.

W4 development contracts. Fake controller records are not live ZAP proof.
Offline contracts: expectations describe permitted conclusions, not scan results.

HTTP boundary integration with simulated native receipts (not live ZAP proof).

findings.issue: Declared authenticated ordinary zap_attack_start without authSessionId was accepted when candidate metadata claimed a validated session. Authentication was not actually attached to the request.
